title: What's New: Document Preview in E-Documents (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Background on electronic documents and compliance
E-document card and lines display demo
Extracted data view and PDF attachments
Call to action for related sessions

features.name: Document preview in e-documents
features.description: Users can now preview incoming electronic documents before processing them, viewing extracted human-readable information from XML files including header and line details from vendor documents.

features.name: Two-step e-document processing
features.description: Electronic documents can now be processed in two steps - first creating a training document, then deciding whether to process and create a purchase invoice - as an alternative to the default automatic one-step processing.
caveats: Both one-step and two-step processing are options; one-step remains the default

features.name: Extracted data view for e-documents
features.description: A new extracted data view displays both header information and line information from received XML documents, allowing users to inspect complete details before deciding to process the e-document into a purchase document.

features.name: Embedded PDF attachments in e-documents
features.description: PDFs that are embedded in XML e-documents are now automatically extracted and stored as attachments, allowing users to open and inspect original vendor documents directly from the e-document card.
caveats: Works with XML files that have embedded PDFs

features.name: E-document card improvements
features.description: The e-document card page now includes improved fact boxes with service and locks information, and a new attachments fact box for viewing extracted PDFs.

features.name: E-document lines subform
features.description: A new subform on the e-document card page displays the lines that were received in the XML, working for both processed and unprocessed documents, with GL account information where applicable.
